scope.direct_result: two connected subsets of E=Q(i*sqrt(3),i*sqrt(11)) whose placed union contains a cross K2,2 have a four-colorable strict unit-distance graph
scope.mixed506_corollary: every placement of the fixed 292-vertex B and 214-vertex V containing a cross four-cycle is four-colorable
scope.combined_single_hub_corollary: a non-four-colorable disjoint mixed506 placement must have a four-cycle-free cross graph and at most one cross-degree-at-least-three hub, of degree at most ten
